component.name: Doudou
component.summary: Cross-platform music player for your media server

description.p: A cross-platform music player that connects to your own media server. Stream your library, or pull from YouTube Music - all without ads, trackers, or cloud lock-in.

ul.li: Gapless playback with a proper queue and history
Background audio on mobile and desktop
Download songs, albums, and playlists for offline listening
Radio mode that keeps the music going
Automatic transcoding when your server supports it
Dynamic themes pulled from album artwork

description.p: Supports Subsonic/OpenSubsonic, YouTube Music, Jellyfin, and Plex backends.
